properties.coordinateSystem: WGS84 longitude/latitude, inverse of source game projection

classification: core-touches: positive-area square intersection with exact runtime drive cells. ring-touches: no drive cell intersection, but square minimum distance to source analytic bands/circles/polygons <= 600 m. outside-ring: optional distant context.
coverage: Every 250 m grid cell intersecting the runtime playable mask or exact analytic 600 m ring is included. This describes capture coverage only; it is not a fidelity score.
